data.name: Ghafur
data.gender_notes: Ghafur is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who covers up (sins) and forgives. In the Quran, Allah is called Ghafur and Al-Ghaffar, signifying His limitless power to forgive sins. The name Ghafur carries the meaning “The Forgiver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghafur usually hope their child will grow to embody the forgiver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and forgiveness.
data.etymology: Ghafur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Forgiver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghafur total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: غفور
in_arabic.long_meaning: غفور هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ومعناه الّذي يغفر الذنوب، ويستجيب لدعوات عباده، ويتفضل عليهم برحمته الواسعة، ورد في القرآن الكريم في العديد من الأيات، مثل قوله تعالى: {وَإَنَّ رَبَّكَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ}، ويحمل هذا الاسم معنى روحياً كبيراً في الإسلام، حيث يُعتبر من أسماء الله التي تثلج الصدور، وتعطى الأمل للعباد في مغفرة الذنوب

in_urdu.name: غفور
in_urdu.long_meaning: غفور ایک اسم گرامی ہے جو الہی صفات میں سے ایک ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے گناہوں کو معاف کرنے والا، اور یہ قرآن مجید میں متعدد جگہوں پر ذکر ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد باری تعالی ہے: {وَإَنَّ رَبَّكَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ}، اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت اسلام میں بہت زیادہ ہے، کیونکہ یہ الہی ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو دل کو تسلی دیتا ہے اور بندوں کو گناہوں کی معافی کی امید دیتا ہے

in_hindi.name: ग़फ़ूर
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़फ़ूर एक पवित्र नाम है जो अल्लाह की विशेषताओं में से एक है, इसका अर्थ है पापों को क्षमा करने वाला, और यह कुरआन में कई स्थानों पर उल्लेखित है, जैसे कि भगवान का कथन है: {वَإَنَّ رَبَّكَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ}, इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक महत्व इस्लाम में बहुत अधिक है, क्योंकि यह अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है जो दिल को शांति देता है और बंदों को पापों की क्षमा की आशा देता है

in_pashto.name: غفور
in_pashto.long_meaning: غفور د الله تعالی له ښکلیو نومونو څخه دی، د هغه معنا دا ده چې ګناهونه بخښونکی دی، او دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې په ډېرو ځایونو کې ذکر شوی دی، لکه څنګه چې الله تعالی وایی: {وَإَنَّ رَبَّكَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ}، دا نوم د اسلام په دین کې ډېر重要 دی، ځکه چې دا د الله له نومونو څخه دی چې زړونه ته ځانگړتیا ورکوي او بنده یې د ګناهونو د بخښنې په هیله ډاله کوي

in_english.name: Ghafur
in_english.long_meaning: Ghafur is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning The Forgiver of sins, and it is mentioned in the Quran in several places, such as {وَإَنَّ رَبَّكَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ}. This name holds significant spiritual importance in Islam, as it is one of Allah's names that brings comfort to the heart and gives hope to the servants for the forgiveness of sins

data.cultural_impact: The name Ghafur is rooted in the Islamic faith, where it highlights one of the many virtues of Allah, the ultimate forgiver. This name holds significant importance in Muslim communities, as it is a constant reminder of Allah's mercy and forgiveness. As a result, it has filtering down into their daily lives, encouraging a culture of seeking forgiveness and extending it to others.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ghafur is highly spiritual in nature, as it connects one to the divine power and mercy of Allah. It serves as a reminder of the infinite gifts of Allah, and inspires individuals to turn towards Him for forgiveness and grace. The spiritual significance of the name Ghafur is deeply personal, as it invites us to reflect on our own transgressions, and seek His mercy through sincere repentance and earnest devotion. Furthermore, the name Ghafur embodies the essence of Islam, which emphasizes onto compassion, mercy, and forgiveness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Forgiver" symbolizes One who covers up (sins) and forgives. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ghafur serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the forgiver.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: The name Ghafur is derived from the Arabic root gh-f-r, which means 'to cover', 'to conceal', and 'to forgive'. In Islamic tradition, Allah (God) is referred to as Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim (The Most Gracious, The Most Merciful) and Al-Ghafur (The Forgiving). This name is mentioned in numerous verses of the Quran.

Ghafur is also one of the ninety-nine beautiful names of Allah in Islamic tradition. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is reported to have said, 'Whoever calls upon Allah using one of His beautiful names, Allah will call him with ten names that are better than it.' The name Ghafur is believed to bring forgiveness and mercy from Allah.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ghafur in Islam is commonly associated with the attributes of forgiveness, compassion, and mercy. In the modern context, this name is celebrated and explored across various platforms. On Social Media, hashtags like #Ghafur and #Forgiveness are used to share stories and messages of forgiveness and compassion. In Literature, authors write about characters named Ghafur to highlight the themes of mercy and forgiveness. In Music, artists create compositions with the name Ghafur in the title or lyrics to express the message of compassion and forgiveness.
